goal: Let the operator replay a completed flight from FlightDetail: an aircraft marker animates along the recorded track with play/pause, speed control and a scrubber, plus a live instrument readout (alt, IAS, GS, heading, VS, on-ground). Client-only; reuses the points GET /api/flights/:id already returns. No schema/endpoint/agent change.
frozen_decisions: Begin designing and planning the development of a flight replay feature. (user, verbatim)

Orchestrator defaults, overridable by user: replay is for completed flights, entered from FlightDetail; real timestamps compressed by a speed multiplier with long recording gaps collapsed; read-only, no schema/ingest/agent change; PrintFlight/PrintTrip and KML export untouched.
open_questions: Camera: fixed overview vs follow-aircraft (default: toggle, follow on)
ACARS/OOOI events on the scrubber (default: phase 2, droppable)
Trip-level replay across legs (default: out of scope)
Replay of in-progress flights (default: no, LiveMap covers live)
design_scope: Client FlightPoint type mismatch: client/src/types.ts declares {lat,lon,altitude_ft,timestamp} but the server sends ts, airspeed_kts, ground_speed_kts, heading_deg, vertical_speed_fpm, on_ground (0|1). Freeze the widened type (ts name, on_ground number) and confirm AltitudeChart/downsample/FlightMap do not break.

Engine API in client/src/utils/replay.ts: buildTimeline(points, opts{gapThresholdSec, ...}) -> Timeline {virtualDurationSec, segments}; sample(timeline, virtualT) -> {lat, lon(unwrapped), heading, altitude_ft, ias, gs, vs, onGround, pointIndex}; speed steps list; virtual<->real mapping for scrubber labels; gap-collapse rule (gap > N x RECORD_INTERVAL 5s collapsed to a fixed short virtual span, marker holds); heading interpolation shortest-arc; ground/altitude/speed linear; on_ground stepwise; edge cases (0/1 point, duplicate ts, unsorted, NaN ts).
Antimeridian: engine uses unwrapLonChain over the FULL (not downsampled) chain so marker lon matches the polyline drawn by FlightMap (which also unwraps); interpolate in unwrapped space.

Animation approach: a single requestAnimationFrame loop owned by a hook (useReplayClock) holding virtual time in a ref; marker moved imperatively via L.Marker.setLatLng/icon element rotation (as LiveMap does); scrubber and readout update via throttled state (<=10 Hz) or direct DOM refs; no per-frame React re-render of the map. Clock injectable for tests (fake rAF/performance.now).

Component seam: new ReplayPanel (map + controls + readout) rendered in FlightDetail behind a 'Replay' toggle/button; reuse FlightMap unchanged if possible (optional children/prop), otherwise add an optional prop that print pages never pass. Freeze which.

Payload decision (proposed: NO backend change): 5 s interval => ~0.7k pts/h, ~150 B each, a 10 h flight ~1 MB, already fetched by FlightDetail today. Designer confirms and records; a slim /points endpoint is a deferred follow-up only if a real flight proves it slow.
sequencing_rationale: Only a small contract exists (engine API, point type, FlightMap seam), so one Designer task precedes code; no backend work at all, hence no backend tasks and no devops.
Engine is a pure module with Vitest unit tests (falsifiable without React/Leaflet); UI depends on it.

Engine and UI are sequential (UI imports the engine and widened types), and both live in client/**, so one frontend_sr owns them in a single batch is acceptable; they are kept as two tasks only so the reviewer can gate the pure module first. The Orchestrator may batch T-002+T-003 into one implementer (same role, dependency chain).
Phase 2 (ACARS ticks on the scrubber) is optional polish, split so phase 1 ships a complete replay first.
Docs (docs/usage.md, README) are not a task: Orchestrator runs /update-docs after approval.
